description: Use when an agent must decide whether to add or keep a dependency. Input: package, ecosystem (npm, PyPI, crates.io), optional version (default latest). Output: JSON flags (deprecated, yanked, outdated, vulnerable, no_license, no_release_2y), latest version, license, publish dates, maintainer count, downloads, repository, OSV advisories. Example: ?package=request&ecosystem=npm Price: $0.01 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

package.description: Package name as in its registry (npm scopes allowed: @scope/name)

version.description: Exact released version (default: latest); unknown version → 404, not charged

name: dev_package
title: Package health check: npm, PyPI, crates.io version, license, deprecation, downloads, vulnerabilities
